blocks.title: Before you start
blocks.text: Use a new local practice folder. Menu names may vary slightly by platform. No account, extensions or paid service are needed just to read these lessons.
This course teaches the basics. It does not cover every feature of VS Code. Keep real personal data and secret keys out of practice files.
